owner_direction: Internal physics-engine-like components may be fused when useful, while preserving reality calibration and anti-circularity boundaries.
design_goal: Add a source-supported physics-informed constraint layer to the Reality-Calibrated family without pretending that physics alone determines Japanese keirin tactics or outcomes.

layer_1_physics.purpose: Constrain what motions/energy costs are physically plausible at rider and pack level.
explicit_non_assumptions: No single universal CdA is asserted for all riders.
No single fixed drafting percentage is asserted.
No track-length-only deterministic winner effect is asserted.
No physics coefficient may be selected because PEER, N1, C1 or C0 benefits.

layer_2_tactical_state_machine.purpose: Represent Japanese-keirin-specific strategic interactions that cannot be derived from mechanics alone.
layer_2_tactical_state_machine.rule: Transition probabilities/effects remain UNKNOWN or ASSUMPTION_RANGE unless source-supported; candidate architecture may not define the truth transition family.

layer_3_uncertainty_and_human_variation.purpose: Prevent deterministic pseudo-physics from becoming a false reality claim.
layer_3_uncertainty_and_human_variation.rule: Use source-supported ranges or broad sensitivity families; do not invent precise point truth merely to make a simulator run.

physics_literature_anchors.topic: velodrome power model with straights/arcs/transitions/banking and dissipative forces
track cycling mathematical model including banking/tyre effects
competitive cyclist drafting interaction measured in field protocols
cycling aerodynamics review including multi-rider drafting

anti_affinity_contract: Physics equations and uncertainty ranges must be frozen independently of candidate results.
Matched truth/candidate controls, if later used, must be labeled ENGINEERING or ORACLE_LIKE and excluded from reality claims.
The physics layer may constrain feasible motion/energy but may not silently encode PEER same-line arithmetic-mean truth or N1 same/follower/chain truth.
Tactical transition families must include multiple plausible alternatives before any candidate evaluation.
A fresh seed does not cure truth-model affinity.

implementation_strategy.not_required_initially: full CFD or general-purpose rigid-body game engine
implementation_strategy.reason: The research need is controlled sensitivity over force/cost relationships and tactical states, not photorealistic bicycle dynamics.
future_optional_modules: higher-fidelity drafting lookup table from literature/CFD-derived ranges
